speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text: The history of a recent camping trip in Minnesota, followed by self-resolving knee pain and now wrist involvement with fever, strongly suggests Lyme disease. Given your sexual activity, could you tell me if you have experienced any flu-like symptoms or rashes in the genital area? REQUEST TEST: Lyme_serology, ESR, CRP

speaker: Doctor

text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Sweet Syndrome (Acute Febrile Neutrophilic Dermatosis)
